title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU agri-food promotion policy
part_text: 13. Emphasises that, at the same time, the promotion policy must remain an economic and balanced instrument aimed at supporting the competitiveness of European agri-food products and should remain consistent with other EU policies, particularly on health, animal welfare, biodiversity and the climate; supports the introduction of new eligibility criteria for gaining access to such funding, taking into account impacts on animal welfare, biodiversity and the climate, including proportionate exclusions or restrictions on the promotion of certain types of products or categories of products included in the regulation; stresses the importance of guaranteeing fair and equal treatment of all eligible agricultural sectors and products, including plant-based alternatives; recalls that this support is all the more essential as these same products are actively being promoted by third countries in the European internal market;
